join.method: row i <-> i-th response (experiments in chronological order, task dirs sorted, as correlate_structure_metrics.load_all_runs); accepted only if structure, task_slug and all 20 response-derived columns match (rel. tol. 1e-09); otherwise a unique full-fingerprint match among unused rows

table2.title: Table 2 — Discussion-stage metrics by topology
notes: All metrics are discussion-stage only unless marked [NOT disc-only].
Percent changes are relative to the Sequential baseline.

footnotes.text: LLM TCP bytes / run: computed as tcp_bytes_llm_mean_Bps × disc_duration_s (discussion-windowed rate × discussion duration). This gives bytes transferred during the discussion window only.

iat.definition: Discussion-stage inter-arrival times: per run, sorted start_time_utc of the LLM calls labelled horizontal_discussion / synthesize_discussion (Sequential), plus vertical_solver / vertical_reviewer (Star), full_mesh_message / synthesize_discussion (Full Mesh); consecutive differences pooled over runs (_compute_table2.collect_iats). Burst = IAT < 50 ms.
iat.bins_note: 8 log-spaced bins per decade, edges 0.05 s * 10^(j/8); counts[i] covers [bins_s[i], bins_s[i+1]); underflow / overflow count values outside; fit_counts bins the fit sample. linear_bins_s / linear_counts / linear_fit_counts: the same on 0.25 s linear bins over [0, 30) s for the linear-scale view (linear_overflow: IATs beyond).
iat.fit_scope: Paper Table 3 (tab:gof) pipeline, make_session_proxy_figures.py: pooled IATs > 0; 3x IQR upper fence (Q3 + 3 IQR) for Sequential and Star; IAT > 50 ms (reasoning-phase mode); values above the 99th percentile of that sample dropped. Maximum likelihood with location 0. lognormal: mu, sigma of ln(IAT); exponential: lambda = 1/mean; weibull: shape, scale. ks: one-sample KS statistic; p_value: exact two-sided KS distribution (scipy.stats.kstest), not corrected for estimated parameters; aic = 2k - 2 log L.

metrics.label: Discussion calls
metrics.description: Number of discussion calls in the run.

metrics.label: Discussion duration
metrics.description: Last minus first discussion-call start time.

metrics.label: Discussion tokens
metrics.description: Prompt + completion tokens of all discussion calls (llm_meta).

metrics.label: Mean call latency
metrics.description: Mean end-to-end duration of a discussion call (duration_seconds, timed by the calling agent).

metrics.label: Mean discussion IAT
metrics.description: Mean gap between consecutive discussion-call starts = duration / (calls - 1).

metrics.label: Call latency p50
metrics.description: Median discussion-call duration within the run.

metrics.label: Call latency p95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of discussion-call durations within the run.

metrics.label: TTFT p50
metrics.description: Median time to first token of the run's discussion calls: llm_meta.queue_wait_s, timed by the vLLM server from submission to the first output (queueing + prefill). Same values as llm_queue_wait_p50_mean_s.

metrics.label: TTFT p95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of llm_meta.queue_wait_s (time to first token) of the run's discussion calls. Same values as llm_queue_wait_p95_mean_s.

metrics.label: Mean in-flight calls
metrics.description: Time-weighted mean number of concurrent discussion calls over the discussion window ([start, start + duration] intervals).

metrics.label: Peak in-flight calls
metrics.description: Maximum number of concurrent discussion calls.

metrics.label: Queue wait p50
metrics.description: Median llm_meta.queue_wait_s of the run's discussion calls (duplicate of TTFT p50).

metrics.label: Queue wait p95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of llm_meta.queue_wait_s (duplicate of TTFT p95).

metrics.label: Prompt tokens/s
metrics.description: Prompt tokens of all discussion calls / discussion duration.

metrics.label: Completion tokens/s
metrics.description: Completion tokens of all discussion calls / discussion duration.

metrics.label: Mean IAT
metrics.description: Mean discussion-call IAT (identical to disc_mean_iat_s).

metrics.label: Burstiness (max/mean IAT)
metrics.description: Largest discussion IAT of the run divided by its mean IAT (runs with >= 3 calls).

metrics.label: Max IAT
metrics.description: Largest discussion IAT of the run, in seconds (named burstiness_max in the paper's code).

metrics.label: IAT p50
metrics.description: Median discussion IAT within the run (Table 2 'IAT jitter p50' is its mean over runs).

metrics.label: IAT p95
metrics.description: 95th percentile of the run's discussion IATs.

metrics.label: TCP RTT p50
metrics.description: RTT of the TCP handshake from Agent A to the model server, histogram p50; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end]. Constant (0.25 ms) in every run, so it carries no information.

metrics.label: TCP RTT p95
metrics.description: RTT of the TCP handshake from Agent A to the model server, histogram p95; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end]. Constant (0.475 ms) in every run.

metrics.label: TCP flow duration p50
metrics.description: TCP flow duration Agent A -> LLM, histogram p50; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end]. Not discussion-only: flows span the whole task.

metrics.label: TCP flow duration p95
metrics.description: TCP flow duration Agent A -> LLM, histogram p95; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end]. Not discussion-only.

metrics.label: LLM TCP byte rate
metrics.description: Bytes/s sent by the LLM backend, mean; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end].

metrics.label: Peak LLM TCP byte rate
metrics.description: Bytes/s sent by the LLM backend, max; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end].

metrics.label: TCP bytes/s A->LLM
metrics.description: Bytes/s Agent A -> LLM backend, mean; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end].

metrics.label: TCP bytes/s B->LLM
metrics.description: Bytes/s of all Agent B instances -> LLM backend (summed per sample), mean; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end].

metrics.label: TCP bytes/s A->B
metrics.description: Bytes/s Agent A -> all Agent B instances (summed per sample), mean; measured passively on the network, samples inside the discussion window [first discussion-call start, last discussion-call end].

correlations.method: Spearman rank correlation, pairwise-complete rows, average ranks for ties (pandas DataFrame.corr(method='spearman')); null where a column is constant
